title: Deterministic 3-Pass Prompt Pruning with Fixed-Point Idempotence

claims.assertion: A 3-pass compiler pipeline (expired tool drop -> duplicate dedup -> dependency restore) satisfies fixed-point idempotence f(f(x)) == f(x).
claims.evidence: Contract verification test test_fixed_point_idempotence verifies zero additional message removals on repeated passes.

claims.assertion: Non-invasive strategy injection via DefaultContextOptimizerService.register_strategy() preserves micro-kernel constructor contracts (Rule 19).
claims.evidence: PromptPruningPlugin registers strategy at IoC load without modifying StepExecutionEngine contracts.
